result.text:
### Q1
No. The JSON file store stays because ops runs a nightly rsync diff over `data/store.json`, so SQLite was ruled out.

### Q2
Yes, `src/legacy/` must never be modified. It's vendored code, and a platform-team sync job overwrites it every Monday. Also, `docs/erp-api.md` belongs to the ERP team and must not be edited.

### Q3
The signature goes in a top-level `sig` body field, computed as HMAC-SHA256 (hex) over the JSON body without `sig`, with `sig` appended last. A signature header was apparently the alternative, and it fails because the ERP gateway strips custom `X-` headers. Beyond that, the handoff doesn't say what was tried, so I can't tell you more.

### Q4
Port 9911. The sandbox moved there in October, and `config/default.json` still has the old 8080. `ERP_URL` overrides the config.

### Q5
The `message` field must be in German for new errors, since it's shown verbatim to packers. The `code` field stays English SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE. Existing English messages were left alone.

### Q6
`src/services/holidays.ts` has a hardcoded list of Austrian nationwide holidays for 2026 and 2027, with `isPublicHoliday`. `isBusinessDay` in `eta.ts` uses it. It's hardcoded because the deployment is offline. Dates outside those years are treated as having no holidays, so the list needs extending before 2028.

### Q7
No. The ERP answers 422 to arrays and accepts only one event object per request, so batching was not built.

### Q8
No new npm dependencies, runtime or dev, because each one needs a security review of about six weeks.

### Q9
Yes. ETA memoization was added and then removed completely at the user's request, so caching ETAs is a dead end for them. QA had reported stale ETAs, but I couldn't reproduce that over HTTP.

### Q10
`postToErpWithRetry` makes 3 attempts in total, with a fixed 30 s delay and no backoff. It retries network errors and 5xx, but not 4xx. The worst case is 75 s, which fits inside the ERP's 2-minute dedup window, and a test guards that sum. It resends an identical body.

### Q11
Never log recipient name, address or phone, because of GDPR (flagged by the DPO). Shipment IDs and tracking numbers are fine to log.

### Q12
Yes, `emits webhook on delivered` in `test/events.test.ts` (OPS-412, owned by the platform team). If it fails, rerun once and don't fix it.

### Q13
ATP (Austrian Post) numbers are validated with the S10 check digit in `src/lib/s10.ts`, wired into `validate.ts`. An invalid one gives 400 `INVALID_TRACKING_NUMBER` with a German message, and this also applies to `POST /import`. Other carriers accept any non-empty value. The handoff doesn't give the reason for choosing this approach, so I can't tell you why.

### Q14
Nothing has been built or tried yet. The only known fact is that a future hot reload must use `fs.watchFile` polling, because `fs.watch` never fires on the staging Docker bind mount from a Windows host.

### Q15
Yes, `GET /shipments/:id`. The mobile app v2.3 parses it strictly, and its next release is in January. A test pins its exact key set.
